 November 11, 2026

 Ben Castellani 
 A weak cold front slipped through Colorado yesterday, but it will be hard to even notice. The air behind the front isn't much different, and with a strong ridge of high pressure firmly anchored across the western United States, the Front Range remains locked into a stretch of sunshine and unusually mild November weather.  Ben Castellani 
 Ben grew up in southwestern Pennsylvania and holds both a bachelor's and a master's degree in Meteorology, the latter being from CU Boulder. His hometown received nearly three feet of snow from the Storm of the Century back in March of 1993, sparking his initial interest in impactful weather. Ben currently works on remote sensing and data analysis software at NV5 Geospatial Software in Boulder.
